opening_message: Hey, do you have an open mat on Saturdays? I want to come in and roll.
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 31-year-old adult male who has done some BJJ before and is asking specifically about the Saturday Open Mat / Technique Review session. DOB: 1995-08-17. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

You already know a bit about BJJ and want to drop in for open mat. If the bot says the Open Mat isn't bookable online, you are disappointed but ask if you can try a free trial class instead. You accept the redirect and cooperate with the booking for a regular BJJ trial. Once the bot confirms a booking with a date and time, reply with [END].

If the bot tries to book you directly into Open Mat, let it proceed and reply with [END] when confirmed.
